feedback: Written before this candidate races, so it states no outcome for it. The candidate is valid and changes one field from the best raced design (iteration 1, score 128.9): sensor_size 0.012 to 0.016. The controller stays at base_speed 1.3, kp 2.0, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], last_direction. That isolates the footprint effect, which is what the iteration 1 telemetry asked for. In iteration 1 every run ended off_track with max_error about 0.062 to 0.063 m against the 0.06 m limit, and line_loss_events were 1.0 to 1.9 per run (oval 1.9, s-bend 1.85, slalom 1.0). The line is still being lost, so the footprint change is the right first lever. Steering_oscillation was 0.14 to 0.28, which is low enough that kd 0.3 is not yet a problem. Risk to watch: a 16 mm footprint on a 12 mm sensor pitch makes each reading less sharp across the tape edge, so the signal may be less responsive on tight bends. Next race: (a) if line_loss_events drop but max_error still reaches about 0.06 m on the s-bend or slalom, the limit is steering authority on bends, not signal loss, so raise controller.kp in steps of about 0.5 (2.0 to 2.5) and keep sensor_size 0.016. (b) If the robot stays on the line (max_error well under 0.06 m, line_loss_events near 0) but completion_time is above 3 s, raise controller.base_speed in steps of 0.2 (1.3 to 1.5), keeping kd 0.3. (c) If line loss persists at 1 or more per run even at 0.016, do not change the footprint again (it is already the maximum); change controller.line_loss only if the loss events fall with it, otherwise look at sensor weights.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall but max_error still reaches about 0.06 m on the s-bend or slalom: raise controller.kp from 2.0 to 2.5 (then 3.0 if needed), keeping geometry.sensor_size 0.016 and kd 0.3.

If the robot stays on the line (max_error well under 0.06 m, line_loss_events near 0) but completion_time exceeds 3 s: raise controller.base_speed from 1.3 to 1.5, keeping kd 0.3 and sensor_size 0.016.

If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more per run with sensor_size 0.016: the footprint is at its maximum, so test controller.line_loss as the only change next (for example search_right in place of last_direction) and keep the rest fixed, as the iteration 1 evidence showed the footprint alone is not enough.
